spec.claim_summary: Base long entry when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28 with DCA averaging ladder and 3% take profit above average entry.
assumptions: Direction is long: base order in a DCA ladder is a buy.
Asset is BTCUSDT from page context; claim text names no asset.
Entry compiled as RSI(14) crosses_below 28 on bar close; fill at next open per engine rules.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Five averaging orders at fixed deviations (-2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25%) after base entry - averaging / DCA ladder and pyramiding cannot be expressed; only the base RSI entry is compiled.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: 1.8x size scaling per rung is position sizing and is not part of the testable rule.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: Take Profit is 3% above average entry of the filled ladder; schema has only fixed target from single entry, so compiled as take_profit_pct 3.0 which differs once any averaging order fills.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: 'Stop Loss: None - ladder allocation is the structural risk cap' - no stop compiled.
Test window cited is recorded in claimed only; engine tests all available history.

audit_majors: entry: Claim requires five averaging/DCA orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16%, -25% after base entry. Spec compiles only the base RSI entry and omits the ladder, which defines position averaging and therefore entries tested.

take_profit_pct: Claim take profit is 3% above average entry of the filled ladder. Spec compiles take_profit_pct 3.0 from single entry, which the spec itself notes differs once any averaging order fills, changing exit level and verdict.
